safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention denial of throat closing sensation.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In a possible anaphylactic reaction, documenting whether the patient does or does not feel throat closing is clinically important for tracking severity and escalation. Omission of the denial could lead to overestimation of airway involvement and unnecessary urgency/interventions, though the patient was already appropriately directed to emergency care.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated contains no allergy documentation (penicillin allergy not captured).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document a penicillin allergy can directly lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of a penicillin-class antibiotic in future encounters, which can trigger severe allergic reactions including anaphylaxis. Allergies are high-risk safety-critical data elements and omission can result in serious harm.
